evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-atmosphere measurement is unavailable.
Tube pressure was 3.147 Torr before growth at approximately 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure has risen progressively during growth to 3.526 Torr despite essentially unchanged temperature and Ar flow; the cause and acceptable pressure range are not established.
Temperature is 750.3 °C versus 750 °C setpoint, Ar is 99.8 sccm versus 100 sccm, and controller reports running; these do not verify the atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning calibrated exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; expected growth-pressure limits and leak/exhaust-conductance checks would resolve the pressure trend. Sample characterization is not yet available.
